major_concerns: Verifier coverage may miss relevant safety properties (false negatives/positives).
Repair prompting strategy is underspecified; model may produce syntactically plausible but semantically incorrect repairs.
Latency and end‑to‑end cost not bounded for operational use.
Task set realism and public-data sourcing need clarification to avoid pre‑lock artifacts.
required_design_repairs: Explicitly enumerate verifier properties and limitations; add tests to measure verifier false‑negative/positive rates.
Specify repair prompting template, temperature/seed policy, and failure/no‑improvement stopping rules.
Add latency budgets and measure components; report impact of repair iterations on latency.
Publish the public intent→configuration dataset, seeds, and all prompts; ensure no pre‑lock data leakage.

major_concerns: Simulated cost and human‑penalty models are subjective and may drive results.
Calibration set size and overfitting risks not quantified.
Raw model confidence may be poorly calibrated for the chosen LLM without robust calibration methods.
Operational human factors (acceptance, latency tolerance) are not measured.
required_design_repairs: Define and justify the simulated cost model; include sensitivity sweeps across reasonable cost parameters.
Specify calibration method, held‑out set size, and regularization to avoid overfitting; report ECE/MCE.
Predefine human‑escalation latency/capacity assumptions or evaluate multiple realistic scenarios.
Log all model scores, thresholds, and seeds; provide reproducible policy code and decision thresholds.

major_concerns: Representativeness of public retrieval corpus and synthetic canary simulation may be limited.
Safety‑score weighting is subjective and will affect rankings.
Benchmark construction may unintentionally favor certain defenses (design bias).
required_design_repairs: Publish corpus curation criteria and make corpus and scoring code public for reproducibility.
Provide multiple predefined weighting schemes and sensitivity analyses to show ranking robustness.
Describe canary/rollback simulation mechanics precisely and validate with small real‑world traces if possible (or justify absence).

major_concerns: Retrieval corpus quality and topical coverage determine RAG benefit; corpus construction is underspecified.
Latency measurements can be confounded by API/network variability.
Repair allowance parity between RAG and unguided conditions must be enforced to ensure fair comparison.
required_design_repairs: Specify corpus sources, indexing/retrieval method, and retrieval hyperparameters (k, reranker).
Predefine latency measurement protocol (multiple runs, median/95th, environment control) and report variance.
Ensure identical repair loop and prompt templates for both arms; preregister exact experimental pairing and seeds.
